summary: We developed a web application that allows users to upload space images and compare them with one another. It also gives them the ability to create a short animation that lets viewers easily compare frames and spot any changes. To keep the tool up to date, we added a function to upload new image sets using the upload button
details: Our project is built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, while downloading and preparing the base space images is handled by a Python script. To help build the image visualizer and sequencer, we used Gemini AI as an assistant, as well as to check our HTML and CSS code for critical errors. The main benefits of our project are its easy-to-use, intuitive interface and the ability for users to upload and compare their own image sets. To develop the web application, we used Visual Studio for HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, Google Colab for Python, and Gemini for troubleshooting
